# FBX fixtures

`Knarr.fbx` is the supplied Knarr ship model. It is also the default demo asset and is copied to `dist/assets/Knarr.fbx` by the browser build.

`transformed_instances_ascii.fbx` is authored for WebEngine. It contains a quad instanced twice under a translated parent (including mirrored, nonuniform node scaling and a geometry translation), plus an independent triangle. Units are centimeters; normals are omitted to exercise generation.

`textured_external_ascii.fbx` and `textured_embedded_ascii.fbx` are authored for WebEngine. Two adjacent panels use two material tints and share a texture. The panels share positions but have different UVs at their seam. The embedded variant stores the same PNG as a base64 Video content blob. `uv-colors.png` is an authored 2x2 orientation pattern: top red/green, bottom blue/yellow. The external variant references `Textures/uv-colors.png` to exercise relocated companion resolution by basename.

`blender_cube_binary.fbx` is the upstream ufbx `data/blender_279_default_7400_binary.fbx` fixture from commit `26a482ae66871d7de36eb722aa060bce95bce274` ([source](https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/blob/26a482ae66871d7de36eb722aa060bce95bce274/data/blender_279_default_7400_binary.fbx)). It uses the upstream license at `../../third_party/ufbx/LICENSE`.

Binary fixture SHA-256: `db93866edd663ccc2e68469db6ec65c040e77786b0b128bfc522a7a860d2035c`.
## Skeletal fixtures

`skeletal_column_ascii.fbx` is an original WebEngine test/demo asset: a two-bone
column with four-weight-compatible skin data and two opposing 2-second rotation
clips. It uses centimeters so unit conversion and bind transforms are exercised.
`skeletal_column_binary.fbx` encodes the same original data in FBX 7.4 binary;
regenerate it with `python scripts/generate-skeletal-binary-fixture.py`.
Both files were authored for this repository and have no third-party asset dependency.

## Morph fixtures

`morph_column_ascii.fbx` is an original CC0 column with sparse `Stretch` and `Lean`
blend shapes in centimeters. Stretch defaults to 25 percent; Lean defaults to zero.
The binary version encodes the same data. Regenerate it with:

```sh
python scripts/generate-skeletal-binary-fixture.py --source tests/fixtures/morph_column_ascii.fbx --destination tests/fixtures/morph_column_binary.fbx
```

## Audio fixtures

`audio-tone.mp3` is an original six-second, 44.1 kHz stereo tone with varying
amplitude and 440/660 Hz channels, encoded at 96 kbit/s. It contains no music
or third-party recording. Regenerate it with FFmpeg:

```sh
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "aevalsrc=0.2*sin(2*PI*440*t)*(0.55+0.45*sin(2*PI*t))|0.2*sin(2*PI*660*t)*(0.55+0.45*cos(2*PI*t)):s=44100:d=6" -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 96k tests/fixtures/audio-tone.mp3
```

`audio-tone.wav` contains the same original six-second tone as stereo 16-bit PCM
WAV at 44.1 kHz. Regenerate it using the same command with `-c:a pcm_s16le`
instead of `-c:a libmp3lame -b:a 96k` and the output `tests/fixtures/audio-tone.wav`.


## GLB fixtures

All `.glb` files are original, deterministic test assets generated by
`scripts/generate-glb-fixtures.py`, reusing the existing `uv-colors.png` test image.
They cover embedded/external/base64 images, five PBR texture slots, skin inverse
binds, translation/rotation/STEP/cubic clips, sparse morphs, mirrored instances,
UV sets/transforms, and intentionally malformed files. No third-party model
license is required. Regenerate with `python scripts/generate-glb-fixtures.py`.

## Legacy spatial-query archives

`spatial-legacy-v1.wescene` and `spatial-legacy-v1.weassets` were saved with the
original version-1 engine codec before sensor settings were added. They contain
one static sphere (radius 0.5, layer 3) at {1,2,3} and its collision-shape library.
They verify real version-1 compatibility independently of the version-2 writer.
